subject: wizardBookshelf
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: wizard's bookshelf with tomes, scrolls, orbs and candles.
Style: high-fantasy anime.
reasoning:
I'm reviewing the renders for issues - the back wall mural looks fine with some natural shadowing, but the side panel is too flat and plain, so I should add some decorative detail there to break up the dark purple slab.

I also notice the floating sparkle stars read as thin edge-on lines from the side view since they're flat extrudes facing forward, so I'll add a second rotated star for each to fix that. Checking the dais and bookcase placement, candle positioning, and crystal clusters, everything else seems to fit within bounds reasonably well.

The shelf interiors are too dark for the starry mural to read, so I'm adding a warm glow effect to the back panel texture to brighten it. I also want to richen the wood color from its current dark purple to something more vivid for the fantasy aesthetic, and I'm planning to add gilt-framed glowing emblems to the outer faces of the side panels.

Adding gilt frame boxes...

Placing gold balls along the crest's sloped arch...

Updating sparkle orientations...

I also need to add side panel ball accents inside the loop, extra crest balls near the emblem, and double-check that the options type properly supports the scale property.
